An affected component returned by resolve-component-paths but absent from the Context Projection is silently evaluated against an empty properties document rather than Blocked, against decision v2 s19's governing 'ambiguous => Block' rule and design.md step 7's 'this affected component's Context-Projection entry'. The script_dir prepend to sys.path is never restored (no try/finally, no importlib.util.spec_from_file_location), so any later stdlib-shadowing module in the deployed scripts directory would win import resolution for the rest of the process. Disclosed, unfixed across three rounds on a Security-Sensitive task.
